def mvcc.WsState.addW (σ : mvcc.WsState) (b : Bool) (w : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (st0 :
    mvcc.WatcherSt) (γw : mvcc.WatcherNames) : mvcc.WsState :=
  { Lmu := σ.Lmu, Ws := if b = true then <[w := r]>σ.Ws else σ.Ws, Wu := if b = true then σ.Wu else <[w := r]>σ.Wu,
    ST := <[w := st0]>σ.ST, Wo := σ.Wo, M := <[w := γw]>σ.M, E := <[w := ([], γw.lo)]>σ.E, vs := σ.vs, vbs := σ.vbs,
    VB := σ.VB }

    mvcc.watchableStore.cancelWatcher.spec) : mvcc.watchableStore.watch.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.mvcc.watchableStore.watch.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (key endk fcs : GoSlice) (k e : List w8) (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool))
    (startRev id : w64) (ch : GoChan) (γc : mvcc.WatchChanNames) (L : List Loc) (Back : Loc → IProp GF),
    have P := mvcc.storeWatchParams s st γ;
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,

                ownSlice endk e DFrac.discard ∗

                        P.R ∗
                          P.T ∗

                              P.RegCb ch γc (mvcc.watchRangeOf k e endk startRev id) fs Back -∗
          (▷
              ∀ w c,
                ⌜w ≠ null⌝ ∗
                    P.IW w ∗
                      P.OC w γc ∗
                        mvcc.cancelSpec P c w ∗
                          P.CR ch γc (w :: L) ∗
                            P.R ∗
                              (∃ lo, P.IWF w (mvcc.watchRangeOf k e endk startRev id) fcs lo) ∗
                                ⌜(w :: L).length + 3 ≤ 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗ P.WS w ∗ Back w -∗
                  Φ (intoVal w, intoVal c)) -∗
            WP
              (((((((intoVal
                            (methods go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStore.ty.PointerType
                              go!"watch" (intoVal s)))
                          (intoVal key))
                        (intoVal endk))
                      (intoVal startRev))
                    (intoVal id))
                  (intoVal ch))
                (intoVal fcs))
              {{ Φ }}
